.peers .f{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.78rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere;flex:1}
.count{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink2);margin:6px 0}
.slider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
input[type=range]{width:min(420px,100%);min-height:44px;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.out{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:700;min-width:3.2em;display:inline-block}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px}
@media (max-width:860px){.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
table.cm{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.9rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;width:100%}
table.cm th,table.cm td{border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:8px 10px;text-align:center}
table.cm th{background:#f6f7f8;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2)}
.scrollx{overflow-x:auto}
ul.limits{padding-left:1.2em}
ul.limits li{margin:.45em 0}
footer{padding:40px 0 60px;background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
footer h2{font-size:1.35rem;margin-top:1.4em}
dl.gloss{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,13em) minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px 20px;font-size:.95rem}
dl.gloss dt{font-weight:600}
dl.gloss dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink2)}
@media (max-width:640px){dl.gloss{grid-template-columns:1fr}dl.gloss dd{margin-bottom:8px}}
.prov li{margin:.35em 0;font-size:.93rem}
button.term{font:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0 1px;color:inherit;border-bottom:1.5px dotted var(--accent);cursor:help;min-height:0;line-height:inherit}
.termtip{position:absolute;z-index:60;max-width:320px;background:#1b1d21;color:#fff;font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.45;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.termtip b{display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.note{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:8px}
.more{margin-top:10px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip" href="#main">Skip to main content</a>

<header class="top" role="banner">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="q">Explorable companion to the paper</p>
    <h1>Pre-Registered Cross-Family Solver Consensus Outperforms LLM Judges on Templated NL-to-FOL Translation with a Supplied Predicate Signature</h1>
    <p class="authors">Anonymous</p>
    <div class="links">
      <a class="btn primary" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_Jhw6i0bFXdo3/paper.pdf">Read the paper (PDF)</a>
      <a class="btn" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_Jhw6i0bFXdo3/report.pdf">Read the full research report</a>
      <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_Jhw6i0bFXdo3">Code repository</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<nav class="sections" aria-label="Sections">
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#finding">The finding</a></li>
    <li><a href="#how">How it works</a></li>
    <li><a href="#evidence">Explore the evidence</a></li>
    <li><a href="#try">Try a threshold</a></li>
    <li><a href="#fails">Where it fails</a></li>
    <li><a href="#about">Links and glossary</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<main id="main" tabindex="-1">

<!-- ============================================================ FINDING -->
<section class="block" id="finding" aria-labelledby="h-finding">
 <div class="wrap">
  <div class="finding">
   <div>
    <p class="q">The question</p>
    <h2 id="h-finding">Can agreement between independent translators replace a gold formula?</h2>
    <div class="prose">
    <p>Checking whether a first-order logic formula says what its sentence says usually needs a gold reference, and gold references are often wrong: one audit found errors in 39&ndash;42% of the annotations in two standard benchmarks. The paper tests a gold-free alternative. Ask translators from several independent LLM families to formalise the same sentence, check every pair for logical equivalence with the Z3 solver, and score each candidate by the share of <button class="term" type="button" data-term="family">cross-family</button> peers that disagree with it. This is the <button class="term" type="button" data-term="cscore">consensus score</button>.</p>
    <p>On 221 templated sentences with exception clauses and a <button class="term" type="button" data-term="sig">supplied predicate signature</button>, the pre-registered test compares consensus with a cheap <button class="term" type="button" data-term="disg">disguised</button> LLM judge by <button class="term" type="button" data-term="auroc">within-template AUROC</button>:</p>
    </div>
    <p class="bignum" aria-live="polite"><span id="big-m">&nbsp;</span> <span class="vs">vs <span id="big-b">&nbsp;</span></span></p>
    <p class="bignum-cap">Consensus against the disguised flash-lite judge, recomputed in your browser from the <span id="big-n"></span> rows both scored. The paper reports &Delta; = +0.367 [+0.328, +0.404], which passed the pre-registered criterion.</p>
    <p class="prose">The advantage holds under <button class="term" type="button" data-term="free">free vocabulary</button> too, but smaller: switch the condition on the right.</p>
   </div>
   <div class="view" id="v-head" style="margin-top:0">
    <p class="viewq">Does consensus separate wrong translations from right ones better than a judge?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <fieldset class="ctl"><legend>Vocabulary condition</legend>
        <div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Vocabulary condition">
          <label><input type="radio" name="hcond" value="SIG" checked><span>Shared signature</span></label>
          <label><input type="radio" name="hcond" value="FREE"><span>Free vocabulary</span></label>
        </div>
      </fieldset>
      <label class="ctl"><span>Judge</span>
        <select id="h-judge">
          <option value="jd">flash-lite, disguised</option>
          <option value="jo">flash-lite, original text</option>
          <option value="jl">local Qwen3-8B, disguised</option>
        </select></label>
      <label class="ctl"><span>Sentence length</span>
        <select id="h-terc">
          <option value="all">All lengths</option>
          <option value="W1">Shortest third (W1)</option>
          <option value="W2">Middle third (W2)</option>
          <option value="W3">Longest third (W3)</option>
        </select></label>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="h-paired" checked> Only rows both metrics scored</label>
    </div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-head"></div>
    <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Consensus</span><span><i style="background:var(--base)"></i>LLM judge (baseline)</span><span><i style="background:none;border-left:2px dashed #888;border-radius:0;width:2px"></i>Chance, 0.5</span></div>
    <div class="stats" id="h-stats"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="h-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <p class="note" id="h-note"></p>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<!-- ============================================================ HOW IT WORKS -->
<section class="block" id="how" aria-labelledby="h-how">
 <div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">How it works</p>
  <h2 id="h-how">One real sentence, five stages</h2>
  <p class="prose">Every value in this walk-through is the one the run recorded for this sentence: the ten translations, the Z3 equivalence classes, the peer counts, the labels and the judge scores. The sentence was picked because it shows both what the method catches and what it gets wrong.</p>
  <div class="view" id="v-step">
    <div class="chart" id="c-pipe" aria-hidden="false"></div>
    <ol class="steps" id="step-markers" aria-label="Stages"></ol>
    <div id="step-live" class="sr" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <h3 id="step-title" style="margin-top:4px"></h3>
    <div class="stepbody">
      <div><h4>What goes in</h4><div id="step-in"></div></div>
      <div><h4>What is done</h4><div id="step-do"></div></div>
      <div><h4>What comes out</h4><div id="step-out"></div></div>
    </div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="step-why"></p>
    <div class="stepnav" style="margin-top:14px">
      <button class="plain" type="button" id="step-prev">&larr; Previous stage</button>
      <button class="plain" type="button" id="step-next">Next stage &rarr;</button>
      <span class="small">Left and right arrow keys also move between stages when the stepper has focus.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<!-- ============================================================ EVIDENCE -->
<section class="block" id="evidence" aria-labelledby="h-evi">
 <div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">Explore the evidence</p>
  <h2 id="h-evi">Does it hold everywhere, and what does it do to one item?</h2>

  <div class="view" id="v-strata">
    <h3>Per-template and per-stratum AUROC (shared signature)</h3>
    <p class="viewq">Is the advantage carried by one easy template, or does it hold in each slice of <button class="term" type="button" data-term="rcomp">R_COMP</button>?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label class="ctl"><span>Group rows by</span>
        <select id="s-by">
          <option value="tpl">Template (T1&ndash;T9)</option>
          <option value="clause">Exception clause type</option>
          <option value="terc">Word-length tercile</option>
          <option value="nconds">Number of conditions</option>
        </select></label>
      <label class="ctl"><span>Compare with judge</span>
        <select id="s-judge">
          <option value="jd">flash-lite, disguised</option>
          <option value="jo">flash-lite, original text</option>
          <option value="jl">local Qwen3-8B, disguised</option>
        </select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-strata"></div>
    <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Consensus (c_score_sig)</span><span><i style="background:var(--base)"></i>Judge</span></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="s-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <p class="note">AUROC inside each group is computed from the embedded rows on the rows both metrics scored, pairing errors with correct translations of the same template only. Groups with fewer than 5 errors or 5 correct rows are not drawn.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-browser">
    <h3>Item browser: every shared-signature translation</h3>
    <p class="viewq">What does the consensus score look like on one translation, next to its sentence, its references and the judge's verdict?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label class="ctl"><span>Label</span>
        <select id="b-label">
          <option value="all">All labels</option>
          <option value="ERROR">ERROR</option>
          <option value="CORRECT">CORRECT</option>
          <option value="READING_CHOICE">READING_CHOICE</option>
          <option value="OFF_SIGNATURE">OFF_SIGNATURE</option>
          <option value="UNPARSEABLE">UNPARSEABLE</option>
        </select></label>
      <label class="ctl"><span>Show</span>
        <select id="b-show">
          <option value="all">All rows</option>
          <option value="judge_miss">Errors consensus flags, judge passes</option>
          <option value="cons_miss">Errors consensus passes</option>
          <option value="fa">Correct rows consensus flags</option>
          <option value="strong">Correct rows of the strong reading</option>
        </select></label>
      <label class="ctl"><span>Template</span><select id="b-tpl"><option value="all">All templates</option></select></label>
      <label class="ctl"><span>Sort by</span>
        <select id="b-sort">
          <option value="sent">Sentence order</option>
          <option value="c_desc">Consensus score, high first</option>
          <option value="gap">Consensus minus judge, largest first</option>
          <option value="words">Sentence length, longest first</option>
        </select></label>
      <label class="ctl" style="flex:1;min-width:200px"><span>Search sentence or formula</span><input type="search" id="b-q" placeholder="e.g. unless, Famous, qwen"></label>
    </div>
    <p class="count" id="b-count" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <div class="browser">
      <div>
        <div class="list" id="b-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Translations" tabindex="0"></div>
        <button class="plain more" type="button" id="b-more">Show more</button>
      </div>
      <div class="detail" id="b-detail" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="b-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <p class="note">A row is "flagged" when its score is at least 0.5, the paper's decision threshold. Judge scores are oriented the same way: higher means the judge thinks the translation is wrong.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-dev">
    <h3>Free vocabulary on natural sentences (development set E)</h3>
    <p class="viewq">When each translator picks its own predicate names, does consensus still beat the judges and the other gold-free baselines?</p>
    <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Development set view">
      <button role="tab" id="t-dev-m" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="p-dev-m" type="button">All metrics</button>
      <button role="tab" id="t-dev-k" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="p-dev-k" type="button" tabindex="-1">Number of peer families</button>
    </div>
    <div role="tabpanel" id="p-dev-m" aria-labelledby="t-dev-m">
      <div class="controls">
        <fieldset class="ctl"><legend>AUROC</legend>
          <div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="AUROC type">
            <label><input type="radio" name="devk" value="strat" checked><span>Stratified</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="devk" value="pooled"><span>Pooled</span></label>
          </div></fieldset>
      </div>
      <div class="chart" id="c-dev"></div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Consensus family</span><span><i style="background:var(--base)"></i>LLM judges</span><span><i style="background:var(--other)"></i>Round trip, self-consistency</span><span><i style="background:var(--stack)"></i>Feature stacks</span></div>
      <p class="takeaway" id="d-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <div role="tabpanel" id="p-dev-k" aria-labelledby="t-dev-k" hidden>
      <div class="chart" id="c-k"></div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i>All sentences (band = 95% CI)</span><span><i style="background:var(--base)"></i>Longest tercile (T3)</span></div>
      <p class="takeaway" id="k-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <p class="note">These are aggregate results stored by the run (bootstrap CIs over sentences), drawn as recorded; the per-item development labels are not embedded. <span id="d-n"></span></p>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<!-- ============================================================ TRY IT -->
<section class="block" id="try" aria-labelledby="h-try">
 <div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">Try it</p>
  <h2 id="h-try">Move the decision threshold</h2>
  <p class="prose">Consensus needs Z3 and nine LLM families, so it cannot run inside this page. What can be recomputed honestly is the decision rule: flag a translation when its recorded score reaches a threshold. Drag the threshold and the page recounts recall, <button class="term" type="button" data-term="e">endorsement <i>e</i></button> and <button class="term" type="button" data-term="d">divergence <i>d</i></button> over the 2,024 labelled shared-signature rows.</p>
  <div class="view" id="v-try">
    <p class="viewq">At a given false-alarm rate, how many errors does each metric catch?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label class="ctl"><span>Metric</span>
        <select id="t-metric">
          <option value="c">Consensus (c_score_sig)</option>
          <option value="jd">Judge, flash-lite disguised</option>
          <option value="jo">Judge, flash-lite original text</option>
          <option value="jl">Judge, local Qwen3-8B disguised</option>
        </select></label>
      <div class="ctl"><span id="t-lab">Flag when score &ge;</span>
        <div class="slider"><input type="range" id="t-thr" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.5" aria-labelledby="t-lab" aria-describedby="t-thr-out"><output id="t-thr-out" class="out" for="t-thr">0.50</output></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid2">
      <div>
        <div class="chart" id="c-roc"></div>
        <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Consensus ROC</span><span><i style="background:var(--base)"></i>Judge ROC (same judge as selected, or disguised)</span></div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="scrollx"><table class="cm" id="t-cm" aria-label="Confusion counts at the current threshold"></table></div>
        <div class="stats" id="t-stats"></div>
        <p class="takeaway" id="t-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">ROC curves here are pooled over all templates (every error paired with every correct row) and use each metric's own scored rows, so their areas differ slightly from the within-template AUROC above. At threshold 0.5 the paper reports e = 0.0 and d = 0.260 for consensus.</p>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<!-- ============================================================ FAILS -->
<section class="block" id="fails" aria-labelledby="h-fails">
 <div class="wrap">
  <p class="q">Where it fails</p>
  <h2 id="h-fails">Three places the method breaks</h2>
  <div class="view" id="v-fail">
    <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Failure slice">
      <button role="tab" id="t-f1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="p-f1" type="button">Minority reading</button>
      <button role="tab" id="t-f2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="p-f2" type="button" tabindex="-1">Length, free vocabulary</button>
      <button role="tab" id="t-f3" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="p-f3" type="button" tabindex="-1">Predicate renames</button>
    </div>
    <div role="tabpanel" id="p-f1" aria-labelledby="t-f1">
      <p class="viewq">Which correct translations does consensus flag?</p>
      <p class="prose small" style="color:var(--ink2)">Each template sentence has a weak and a strong reading of its exception clause, and both count as correct. When most families choose the weak reading, a correct translation of the strong one has few equivalent peers.</p>
      <div class="controls"><div class="ctl"><span id="f1-lab">Flag when consensus &ge;</span>
        <div class="slider"><input type="range" id="f1-thr" min="0.05" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.5" aria-labelledby="f1-lab"><output id="f1-out" class="out" for="f1-thr">0.50</output></div></div></div>
      <div class="chart" id="c-f1"></div>
      <p class="takeaway" id="f1-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
      <button class="plain" type="button" id="f1-open">Open these rows in the item browser</button>
    </div>
    <div role="tabpanel" id="p-f2" aria-labelledby="t-f2" hidden>
      <p class="viewq">Does consensus get worse on longer sentences?</p>
      <div class="controls">
        <label class="ctl"><span>Split development set E by</span>
          <select id="f2-dim"><option value="words_tercile">Word-length tercile</option><option value="ncond_bin">Number of conditions</option></select></label>
      </div>
      <div class="chart" id="c-f2"></div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--base)"></i><i>e</i>: errors endorsed by the peer majority</span><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i><i>d</i>: correct items that diverge from the majority</span></div>
      <p class="takeaway" id="f2-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
      <p class="note">Free vocabulary, R_AB population, binary majority rule, values as recorded by the mechanism audit. For comparison, the same split on the shared-signature rows is computed live: <span id="f2-sig"></span></p>
    </div>
    <div role="tabpanel" id="p-f3" aria-labelledby="t-f3" hidden>
      <p class="viewq">What happens when a correct formula only has its predicate names changed?</p>
      <div class="controls">
        <fieldset class="ctl"><legend>Rename type</legend>
          <div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Rename type">
            <label><input type="radio" name="ren" value="RENAME_NONCE" checked><span>Nonsense names</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="ren" value="RENAME_SYN"><span>WordNet synonyms</span></label>
          </div></fieldset>
      </div>
      <div class="chart" id="c-f3"></div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:#b8bcc3"></i>False alarms before the rename</span><span><i style="background:var(--bad)"></i>False alarms after the rename</span></div>
      <p class="takeaway" id="f3-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>
  <ul class="limits prose">
    <li><b>Confirmation on fresh data is incomplete.</b> A held-out set of 550 new sentences (E2-A) was built, but the run's budget ran out before enough items were labelled. On the one testable stratum (short ProverQA sentences) consensus ties a local Qwen-8B judge, &Delta; = +0.003 [&minus;0.042, +0.052]. On 42 long L25 items (35 ERROR / 7 CORRECT, 3 sentences) c_score_align falls to 0.443, an estimate with extreme variance.</li>
    <li><b>The 0.954 result is scoped to templates with a supplied signature.</b> The signature removes the alignment problem entirely, which is why the AUROC is so high. It does not extend to translators that choose their own names.</li>
    <li><b>Free-vocabulary out-of-sample labels are provisional.</b> The gloss gate that would confirm MAPPED rows failed twice (balanced accuracy 0.776, then 0.561, against a 0.90 bar), so no row is a confirmed CORRECT. On a 146-row two-auditor subset the gain over the original-view judge is +0.105 [+0.011, +0.215].</li>
    <li><b>Development labels come from a panel</b> whose agreement is imperfect, and R_COMP-SIG later served as development data for aligner tuning, so the numbers on E are not independent of it.</li>
    <li><b>Error typing does not work outside a shared vocabulary:</b> 0.123 [0.081, 0.169] on E, below the judge (0.326) and the peer-medoid baseline (0.328).</li>
    <li><b>Cost.</b> With k = 9 families on R_COMP-SIG, the amortised consensus cost per candidate is about 19 times one cheap judge call.</li>
    <li><b>Domain.</b> English to FOL only, from MALLS, ProverQA and R_COMP. Other logics, languages and sentence distributions are untested.</li>
  </ul>
 </div>
</section>
</main>

<!-- ============================================================ FOOTER -->
<footer id="about" aria-labelledby="h-about">
 <div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-about" style="margin-top:0">Links</h2>
  <div class="links">
    <a class="btn primary" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_Jhw6i0bFXdo3/paper.pdf">Read the paper (PDF)</a>
    <a class="btn" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic@fork/run_Jhw6i0bFXdo3/report.pdf">Read the full research report</a>
    <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/fork/run_Jhw6i0bFXdo3">Code repository</a>
  </div>

  <h2>Where each view's data comes from</h2>
  <ul class="prov prose">
    <li><b>Headline chart, per-stratum chart, stepper, item browser, threshold view, minority-reading failure:</b> <code>experiment_7/full_method_out.json</code> (dataset R_COMP_SIG, all 2,210 rows: sentence, candidate formula, label, matched reading, Z3 class, peer counts, consensus and judge scores), with the weak and strong reference readings from <code>experiment_7/rcomp/work/rcomp_sentences.json</code>. Every AUROC, rate and count on these views is computed in the page from these rows.</li>
    <li><b>Headline chart, free-vocabulary condition:</b> <code>experiment_13/results/per_item_rcomp_free.jsonl</code>, the untouched rows with a provisional ERROR_CERT or MAPPED label (template, word tercile, c_score_align and both judge views).</li>
    <li><b>Development-set metrics:</b> <code>experiment_6/results/analysis_T1.json</code> (metrics_R_AB) and, for c_exact, <code>experiment_14/results/screen_E.json</code>.</li>
    <li><b>Peer-family curve and length split:</b> <code>evaluation_2/tables/m4_auroc_k_cost.csv</code> and <code>evaluation_2/tables/ed_decomposition_cuts.csv</code>.</li>
    <li><b>Rename false alarms:</b> <code>experiment_8/results/invariance_table.csv</code> (PERTURB controls on development bases, primary threshold).</li>
  </ul>
  <p class="small prose">The extraction script that wrote the embedded JSON reads these files and checks the headline numbers against the paper; nothing on this page is simulated or smoothed.</p>

  <h2>Glossary</h2>
  <dl class="gloss" id="gloss"></dl>
 </div>
</footer>

<div class="tip" id="charttip" role="status" hidden></div>
<div class="termtip" id="termtip" role="tooltip" hidden></div>

<script type="application/json" id="data-sig" data-source="experiment_7/full_method_out.json + experiment_7/rcomp/work/rcomp_sentences.json">__SIG__</script>
<script type="application/json" id="data-free" data-source="experiment_13/results/per_item_rcomp_free.jsonl">__FREE__</script>
<script type="application/json" id="data-dev" data-source="experiment_6/results/analysis_T1.json + experiment_14/results/screen_E.json">__DEV__</script>
<script type="application/json" id="data-ed" data-source="evaluation_2/tables/ed_decomposition_cuts.csv">__ED__</script>
<script type="application/json" id="data-k" data-source="evaluation_2/tables/m4_auroc_k_cost.csv">__K__</script>
<script type="application/json" id="data-rename" data-source="experiment_8/results/invariance_table.csv">__REN__</script>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var $=function(s,r){return (r||document).querySelector(s)};
var $$=function(s,r){return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s))};
function J(id){return JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent)}
var SIG=J('data-sig'), FREE=J('data-free'), DEV=J('data-dev'), ED=J('data-ed'), KC=J('data-k'), REN=J('data-rename');
var S=SIG.sentences, R=SIG.rows;
R.forEach(function(r,i){r.i=i;r.t=S[r.s]});
var FEW={G1:1,G1b:1,G2:1,G3:1,G4:1,G5:1,G6:1,G7:1,G8:1,G9:1};
var POOL=R.filter(function(r){return FEW[r.slot]&&(r.lab==='ERROR'||r.lab==='CORRECT')});
var JNAME={jd:'flash-lite judge (disguised)',jo:'flash-lite judge (original text)',jl:'local Qwen3-8B judge (disguised)',c:'consensus'};
var NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
function f3(x){return x==null||isNaN(x)?'n/a':x.toFixed(3)}
function f2(x){return x==null||isNaN(x)?'n/a':x.toFixed(2)}
function pct(x){return x==null||isNaN(x)?'n/a':(100*x).toFixed(1)+'%'}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]})}
function fmtInt(n){return n.toLocaleString('en-US')}

/* ---------------------------------------------------- statistics */
// within-stratum AUROC: sum_s U_s / sum_s P_s, ties count 0.5 (experiment 7, src/auc_tools.py)
function stratAUC(rows,key,strat){
  var g={};rows.forEach(function(r){var k=strat(r);(g[k]=g[k]||[]).push(r)});
  var U=0,P=0;
  Object.keys(g).forEach(function(k){
    var pos=[],neg=[];g[k].forEach(function(r){(r.lab==='ERROR'?pos:neg).push(r[key])});
    if(!pos.length||!neg.length)return;
    neg.sort(function(a,b){return a-b});
    pos.forEach(function(p){var lo=0,hi=neg.length;while(lo<hi){var m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(neg[m]<p)lo=m+1;else hi=m}
      var below=lo,eq=0;while(lo+eq<neg.length&&neg[lo+eq]===p)eq++;U+=below+0.5*eq});
    P+=pos.length*neg.length});
  return P?U/P:NaN;
}
function counts(rows){var e=0,c=0,s={};rows.forEach(function(r){if(r.lab==='ERROR')e++;else c++;s[r.s!=null?r.s:r.sid]=1});return {n:rows.length,e:e,c:c}}
function roc(rows,key){
  var rs=rows.filter(function(r){return r[key]!=null});
  var P=0,N=0;rs.forEach(function(r){if(r.lab==='ERROR')P++;else N++});
  var th={};rs.forEach(function(r){th[r[key]]=1});
  var ts=Object.keys(th).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return b-a});
  var pts=[{fpr:0,tpr:0,t:Infinity}];
  ts.forEach(function(t){var tp=0,fp=0;rs.forEach(function(r){if(r[key]>=t){if(r.lab==='ERROR')tp++;else fp++}});pts.push({fpr:fp/N,tpr:tp/P,t:t})});
  return pts;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------- chart helpers */
var tipEl=$('#charttip');
function svgEl(tag,attrs,parent){var e=document.createElementNS(NS,tag);for(var k in attrs)e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);if(parent)parent.appendChild(e);return e}
function showTip(html,host,evt,mark){
  tipEl.innerHTML=html;tipEl.hidden=false;
  var hb=document.body.getBoundingClientRect();var x,y;
  if(evt&&evt.clientX!=null&&evt.type!=='focus'&&evt.type!=='keydown'){x=evt.clientX;y=evt.clientY}
  else{var b=mark.getBoundingClientRect();x=b.left+b.width/2;y=b.top}
  var tw=tipEl.offsetWidth,th=tipEl.offsetHeight;
  var left=x-hb.left-tw/2;left=Math.max(8,Math.min(left,document.documentElement.clientWidth-tw-8));
  var top=y-hb.top-th-14;if(y-th-14<0)top=y-hb.top+18;
  tipEl.style.left=left+'px';tipEl.style.top=top+'px';
}
function hideTip(){tipEl.hidden=true}
function bindMark(g,html,host){
  g.setAttribute('tabindex','0');g.setAttribute('role','img');g.classList.add('mark');
  var tmp=document.createElement('div');tmp.innerHTML=html;g.setAttribute('aria-label',tmp.textContent);
  g.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(e){showTip(html,host,e,g)});
  g.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){showTip(html,host,e,g)});
  g.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideTip);
  g.addEventListener('focus',function(e){showTip(html,host,e,g)});
  g.addEventListener('blur',hideTip);
  g.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();showTip(html,host,e,g)});
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(){hideTip()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')hideTip()});
function width(el){return Math.max(280,Math.floor(el.clientWidth||600))}

// horizontal grouped bars: groups=[{label, bars:[{v,color,tip,lo,hi}]}]
function hbars(el,groups,opts){
  opts=opts||{};el.innerHTML='';hideTip();
  var W=width(el),narrow=W<520;
  var labW=opts.labW!=null?opts.labW:(narrow?Math.min(130,W*0.36):Math.min(230,W*0.3));
  var barH=opts.barH||18,gap=opts.gap||4,ggap=opts.ggap||14,top=8,bot=40,right=narrow?44:56;
  var nb=groups.reduce(function(a,g){return a+g.bars.length},0);
  var H=top+bot+nb*(barH+gap)+groups.length*ggap;
  var x0=labW,x1=W-right,xmax=opts.xmax||1,xs=function(v){return x0+(x1-x0)*v/xmax};
  var svg=svgEl('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+H,width:W,height:H,role:'group','aria-label':opts.aria||'Bar chart'},el);
  var grid=svgEl('g',{'class':'grid'},svg),ax=svgEl('g',{'class':'axis'},svg);
  var ticks=opts.ticks||[0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1];
  ticks.forEach(function(t){svgEl('line',{x1:xs(t),x2:xs(t),y1:top,y2:H-bot+4},grid);var tx=svgEl('text',{x:xs(t),y:H-bot+18,'text-anchor':'middle'},ax);tx.textContent=opts.tickFmt?opts.tickFmt(t):t.toFixed(1)});
  var at=svgEl('text',{x:(x0+x1)/2,y:H-6,'text-anchor':'middle'},ax);at.textContent=opts.xlabel||'';
  svgEl('line',{x1:x0,x2:x0,y1:top,y2:H-bot,stroke:'#9ea3aa'},svg);
  var y=top;
  groups.forEach(function(g){
    var gh=g.bars.length*(barH+gap)-gap;
    var lt=svgEl('text',{x:x0-8,y:y+gh/2+4,'text-anchor':'end','class':'lbl',style:'font-size:'+(narrow?11:12.5)+'px;fill:#454a52'},svg);
    var lab=g.label;if(narrow&&lab.length>20)lab=lab.slice(0,19)+'…';lt.textContent=lab;
    if(narrow&&g.label.length>20){var tt=svgEl('title',{},lt);tt.textContent=g.label}
    g.bars.forEach(function(b){
      var gm=svgEl('g',{},svg);
      if(b.v!=null&&!isNaN(b.v)){
        var r=svgEl('rect',{x:x0,y:y,width:Math.max(0,xs(b.v)-x0),height:barH,fill:b.color,rx:2,'class':'hit'},gm);
        if(!reduce){r.style.transition='width .25s'}
        if(b.lo!=null){svgEl('line',{x1:xs(b.lo),x2:xs(b.hi),y1:y+barH/2,y2:y+barH/2,stroke:'#1b1d21','stroke-width':1.4},gm);
          [b.lo,b.hi].forEach(function(v){svgEl('line',{x1:xs(v),x2:xs(v),y1:y+4,y2:y+barH-4,stroke:'#1b1d21','stroke-width':1.4},gm)})}
        var vt=svgEl('text',{x:Math.min(xs(b.hi!=null?b.hi:b.v)+5,W-2),y:y+barH/2+4,'class':'lbl',style:'fill:#1b1d21;font-size:11.5px','text-anchor':xs(b.hi!=null?b.hi:b.v)+40>W?'end':'start'},gm);
        vt.textContent=b.fmt?b.fmt(b.v):f3(b.v);
        svgEl('rect',{x:0,y:y-gap/2,width:W,height:barH+gap,fill:'transparent'},gm);
        bindMark(gm,b.tip,el);
      }
      y+=barH+gap});
    y+=ggap});
  if(opts.refline!=null){svgEl('line',{x1:xs(opts.refline),x2:xs(opts.refline),y1:top,y2:H-bot,stroke:'#777','stroke-dasharray':'4 4'},svg)}
  return svg;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------- tooltips for terms */
var GLOSS={
 family:['Cross-family peers','Translations of the same sentence from other LLM vendor families (the candidate\'s own family is excluded). R_COMP uses 10 few-shot LLM slots across 9 vendor families.'],
 cscore:['Consensus score (c_score)','c_score(c, s) = 1 − (1/k) Σ 1[equiv(c, p_i)]: the share of the k cross-family peer translations p_i that Z3 does not find logically equivalent to the candidate c. Higher means greater divergence from peers and a higher predicted error probability.'],
 sig:['Shared signature (SIG)','All translators receive a supplied predicate vocabulary. Equivalence is a direct Z3 check after case-insensitive symbol normalisation, with no alignment, and labels come from Z3 alone.'],
 free:['Free vocabulary (FREE)','Each translator chooses its own predicate names, so checking equivalence needs a predicate-name aligner before the Z3 check (c_score_align).'],
 disg:['Disguised judge','An LLM judge that reads the sentence and the candidate formula with nonce (nonsense) predicate names, which controls for memorisation of known benchmarks. The original-text view shows the real words.'],
 auroc:['Within-template AUROC','Stratified AUROC: errors are paired only with correct translations from the same source stratum (the sentence template on R_COMP), which removes confounds from stratum-level base rates. 0.5 is chance, 1.0 is perfect separation.'],
 rcomp:['R_COMP','Long templated sentences (at least 25 words, 4 to 5 conditions, one unless / except / provided-that / only-if clause) built from a verified lexicon. 221 sentences gave 2,024 labelled translations: 429 ERROR and 1,595 CORRECT.'],
 e:['Endorsement e','The fraction of ERROR items endorsed by the peer majority (score below the decision threshold): the false negatives of consensus.'],
 d:['Divergence d','The fraction of CORRECT items that diverge from the peer majority (score at or above the threshold): the false positives of consensus. At a binary threshold the AUROC equals 1 − (e + d)/2.'],
 z3:['Z3 equivalence','Two formulas are equivalent when the Z3 SMT solver proves each implies the other. On R_COMP-SIG the labels are Z3 equivalence to trusted-by-construction references.'],
 reading:['Weak and strong reading','Each R_COMP template has one weak and one strong reading of its exception clause. A translation equivalent to either one is labelled CORRECT; READING_CHOICE rows are excluded from the test pool.'],
 E:['Development set E','8,507 rows from 700 sentences from MALLS and ProverQA, translated by 9 LLM families with a frozen few-shot prompt. The primary population R_AB has 2,686 items (1,822 ERROR / 864 CORRECT, 292 sentences).'],
 rab:['R_AB','The primary evaluation population on E: items whose panel labels count as reliable under tiers A and B.'],
 aligner:['Predicate aligner','Maps independently chosen predicate names onto each other before the Z3 check, using structural cost, text-anchor cost and truth-value signatures; the pair is equivalent if any of the k cheapest bijections gives a Z3-verified equivalence.'],
 cnf:['c_nf (name-free)','Consensus with alignment by structural and semantic signatures only, ignoring the words in predicate names. Rename-invariant, but blind to meaning-rename errors.'],
 cexact:['c_exact','Consensus with no alignment: exact-match equivalence only. Immune to rename false alarms but blind to equivalences that differ in vocabulary.'],
 flip:['Rename flip','The false-alarm rate a rename induces on its own: false alarms after a meaning-preserving rename minus the false alarms on the unrenamed base.']
};
(function buildGloss(){var dl=$('#gloss');Object.keys(GLOSS).forEach(function(k){
  var dt=document.createElement('dt');dt.textContent=GLOSS[k][0];dt.id='gt-'+k;
  var dd=document.createElement('dd');dd.textContent=GLOSS[k][1];dd.id='g-'+k;dl.appendChild(dt);dl.appendChild(dd)})})();
var termTip=$('#termtip'),openTerm=null;
function openTip(btn){
  var k=btn.getAttribute('data-term');if(!GLOSS[k])return;
  termTip.innerHTML='<b>'+esc(GLOSS[k][0])+'</b>'+esc(GLOSS[k][1]);termTip.hidden=false;openTerm=btn;
  var b=btn.getBoundingClientRect(),hb=document.body.getBoundingClientRect();
  var tw=termTip.offsetWidth,th=termTip.offsetHeight,vw=document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  var left=Math.max(8,Math.min(b.left-hb.left,vw-tw-8));var top=b.bottom-hb.top+8;
  if(b.bottom+th+10>window.innerHeight&&b.top-th-10>0)top=b.top-hb.top-th-8;
  termTip.style.left=left+'px';termTip.style.top=top+'px';
}
function closeTip(){termTip.hidden=true;openTerm=null}
function wireTerms(root){$$('button.term',root).forEach(function(b){
  if(b._wired)return;b._wired=1;var k=b.getAttribute('data-term');
  b.setAttribute('aria-describedby','g-'+k);b.setAttribute('aria-label',b.textContent.trim()+' (definition)');
  b.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){openTip(b)});
  b.addEventListener('focus',function(){openTip(b)});
  b.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();openTip(b)});
  b.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){if(document.activeElement!==b&&openTerm===b)closeTip()});
  b.addEventListener('blur',function(){if(openTerm===b)closeTip()});
})}
wireTerms(document);
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(openTerm&&!openTerm.contains(e.target))closeTip()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&openTerm)closeTip()});
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){if(openTerm)openTip(openTerm)},{passive:true});

/* ---------------------------------------------------- 1. headline */
var tplOf=function(r){return r.tpl!=null?r.tpl:r.t.tpl};
var tercOf=function(r){return r.terc!=null?r.terc:r.t.terc};
function headRows(){
  var cond=$('input[name=hcond]:checked').value,j=$('#h-judge').value,terc=$('#h-terc').value,paired=$('#h-paired').checked;
  var base=cond==='SIG'?POOL:FREE;
  if(terc!=='all')base=base.filter(function(r){return tercOf(r)===terc});
  var mRows=base.filter(function(r){return r.c!=null&&(!paired||r[j]!=null)});
  var bRows=base.filter(function(r){return r[j]!=null&&(!paired||r.c!=null)});
  return {cond:cond,j:j,terc:terc,paired:paired,m:mRows,b:bRows};
}
function drawHead(){
  var st=headRows();
  var am=stratAUC(st.m,'c',tplOf),ab=stratAUC(st.b,st.j,tplOf);
  var cm=counts(st.m),cb=counts(st.b);
  var mname=st.cond==='SIG'?'Consensus, c_score_sig':'Consensus, c_score_align';
  var groups=[{label:mname,bars:[{v:am,color:'var(--accent)',tip:'<b>'+mname+'</b><br>within-template AUROC '+f3(am)+'<br>'+fmtInt(cm.n)+' rows: '+fmtInt(cm.e)+' ERROR / '+fmtInt(cm.c)+' '+(st.cond==='SIG'?'CORRECT':'MAPPED')}]},
              {label:'Judge: '+JNAME[st.j].replace(' judge',''),bars:[{v:ab,color:'var(--base)',tip:'<b>'+JNAME[st.j]+'</b><br>within-template AUROC '+f3(ab)+'<br>'+fmtInt(cb.n)+' rows: '+fmtInt(cb.e)+' ERROR / '+fmtInt(cb.c)+' '+(st.cond==='SIG'?'CORRECT':'MAPPED')}]}];
  hbars($('#c-head'),groups,{barH:40,gap:6,ggap:12,xlabel:'Within-template AUROC (0.5 = chance)',refline:.5,aria:'Headline AUROC comparison'});
  var tlab={all:'all lengths',W1:'the shortest third of sentences',W2:'the middle third',W3:'the longest third'}[st.terc];
  $('#h-stats').innerHTML='<span>Consensus rows <b>'+fmtInt(cm.n)+'</b> ('+fmtInt(cm.e)+' err)</span><span>Judge rows <b>'+fmtInt(cb.n)+'</b> ('+fmtInt(cb.e)+' err)</span><span>&Delta; <b>'+(am-ab>=0?'+':'')+f3(am-ab)+'</b></span>';
  var lab=st.cond==='SIG'?'shared-signature':'free-vocabulary';
  var take='On '+tlab+' in the '+lab+' condition, consensus reaches '+f3(am)+' against '+f3(ab)+' for the '+JNAME[st.j]+', a gap of '+(am-ab>=0?'+':'')+f3(am-ab)+' AUROC.';
  if(st.cond==='FREE')take+=' Free vocabulary costs consensus about 0.15 AUROC relative to the shared signature, yet it stays ahead of the judge.';
  else if(st.terc!=='all')take+=' The consensus AUROC barely moves across length terciles.';
  $('#h-take').textContent=take;
  var note='';
  if(st.cond==='FREE')note='Free-vocabulary labels are provisional: ERROR_CERT (certified error) vs MAPPED, where MAPPED is an upper bound on CORRECT, on untouched rows only. The local-judge option is not part of the paper\'s free-vocabulary comparison.';
  else note=st.paired?'Paired rows reproduce the paper\'s primary test (1,904 rows for the disguised judge). Untick the box to score each metric on every row it has; the paper\'s tercile table does that for consensus (0.959 / 0.947 / 0.953).':'Each metric uses every row it scored: 2,024 for consensus, fewer for judges that failed on some rows.';
  $('#h-note').textContent=note;
  var jl=$('#h-judge option[value=jl]');jl.disabled=(st.cond==='FREE');
}
$$('input[name=hcond]').forEach(function(r){r.addEventListener('change',function(){if(r.value==='FREE'&&$('#h-judge').value==='jl')$('#h-judge').value='jd';drawHead()})});
['#h-judge','#h-terc','#h-paired'].forEach(function(s){$(s).addEventListener('change',drawHead)});
(function big(){var b=POOL.filter(function(r){return r.c!=null&&r.jd!=null});
  $('#big-m').textContent=f3(stratAUC(b,'c',tplOf));$('#big-b').textContent=f3(stratAUC(b,'jd',tplOf));$('#big-n').textContent=fmtInt(b.length)})();

/* ---------------------------------------------------- 2. stepper */
var EX_ID='1d24fe509f90';
var exS=S.findIndex(function(s){return s.id===EX_ID});
var exRows=R.filter(function(r){return r.s===exS});
var exSent=S[exS];
var CLS_COL=['#1f5ea8','#c07a2c','#3d8a78','#8a4fb0','#b3372f','#6b717b'];
var clsIds=[];exRows.forEach(function(r){if(r.cls&&clsIds.indexOf(r.cls)<0)clsIds.push(r.cls)});
clsIds.sort(function(a,b){return exRows.filter(function(r){return r.cls===b}).length-exRows.filter(function(r){return r.cls===a}).length});
function clsCol(c){var i=clsIds.indexOf(c);return CLS_COL[i%CLS_COL.length]}
function clsName(c){return 'class '+String.fromCharCode(65+clsIds.indexOf(c))}
var focusRow=exRows.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='ERROR'&&r.c===1&&r.jd!=null}).sort(function(a,b){return a.jd-b.jd})[0];
var strongRow=exRows.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='CORRECT'&&r.read==='strong'&&r.jd!=null})[0];
function sigOf(fol){var m={},re=/([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\(([^()]*)\)/g,x;while((x=re.exec(fol))){m[x[1]+'/'+x[2].split(',').length]=1}
  var c={},re2=/[(,]\s*([a-z][A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*(?=[,)])/g;while((x=re2.exec(fol))){if(x[1].length>1)c[x[1]]=1}
  return {preds:Object.keys(m),consts:Object.keys(c)}}
function transList(rows,opts){opts=opts||{};return '<ul class="translist">'+rows.map(function(r){
  var chips='<span class="chip oth">'+esc(r.fam)+'</span>';
  if(opts.cls&&r.cls)chips+='<span class="chip cls" style="color:'+clsCol(r.cls)+'">'+clsName(r.cls)+'</span>';
  if(opts.label)chips+='<span class="chip '+(r.lab==='ERROR'?'err':'ok')+'">'+r.lab+(r.read?' ('+r.read+')':'')+'</span>';
  if(opts.score)chips+='<span class="chip oth">c = '+f3(r.c)+'</span>';
  var hl=opts.hl&&opts.hl.indexOf(r)>=0?' class="hl"':'';
  return '<li'+hl+'>'+chips+'<br><span class="fol">'+esc(r.fol)+'</span></li>'}).join('')+'</ul>'}
var STAGES=[
 {name:'Sentence and signature',title:'1. A long sentence with an exception clause, plus a supplied signature',
  inp:function(){return '<p>“'+esc(exSent.text)+'”</p><p class="small">Template '+exSent.tpl+', '+exSent.words+' words, clause type <i>'+esc(exSent.clause)+'</i>.</p>'},
  act:function(){return '<p>The sentence is generated from a template over a verified lexicon, so its references are trusted by construction. Every translator receives the same predicate signature, read here from the reference formula.</p>'},
  out:function(){var g=sigOf(exSent.weak);return '<p>Predicates: <span class="fol">'+g.preds.map(esc).join(', ')+'</span></p><p>Constants: <span class="fol">'+g.consts.map(esc).join(', ')+'</span></p>'},
  why:'A shared vocabulary means two translations can be compared symbol for symbol. No predicate-name aligner is needed, which is the source of the free-vocabulary failures further down.'},
 {name:'Ten translations',title:'2. Ten LLM slots from nine vendor families translate it',
  inp:function(){return '<p>The sentence, the signature and one frozen few-shot prompt. Only the base model differs between slots.</p>'},
  act:function(){return '<p>'+exRows.length+' slots return a formula at temperature 0. Families: '+Array.from(new Set(exRows.map(function(r){return r.fam}))).map(esc).join(', ')+'. Meta and Google each have two slots.</p>'},
  out:function(){return transList(exRows)},
  why:'The formulas differ on the surface (→ with ∧¬, or a disjunction, or nested implications). Surface comparison cannot tell which of these mean the same thing.'},
 {name:'Z3 classes',title:'3. Z3 groups the translations into equivalence classes',
  inp:function(){return '<p>All '+exRows.length+' formulas over one shared signature.</p>'},
  act:function(){return '<p>Each pair is checked for logical equivalence with the Z3 SMT solver after case-insensitive symbol normalisation. Equivalent formulas share a class.</p>'},
  out:function(){return '<p>'+clsIds.length+' classes, recorded by the run:</p>'+clsIds.map(function(c){var rs=exRows.filter(function(r){return r.cls===c});
    return '<p><span class="chip cls" style="color:'+clsCol(c)+'">'+clsName(c)+'</span> '+rs.length+' translation'+(rs.length>1?'s':'')+': '+rs.map(function(r){return esc(r.slot+' '+r.fam)}).join(', ')+'</p>'}).join('')},
  why:'Six translations that look different are the same formula to Z3. The two stray singletons are the ones to worry about, and the method finds them without reading any reference.'},
 {name:'Consensus score',title:'4. Score each candidate by how many peers disagree',
  inp:function(){return '<p>Candidate '+esc(focusRow.slot)+' ('+esc(focusRow.fam)+'):</p><div class="folbox">'+esc(focusRow.fol)+'</div>'},
  act:function(){var r=focusRow;return '<p>Peers are the translations from the other families: here k = '+r.np+'. Of those, '+r.neq+' are Z3-equivalent to the candidate.</p><p class="fol">c = 1 − '+r.neq+'/'+r.np+' = '+f3(r.c)+'</p>'},
  out:function(){return transList(exRows.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b.c-a.c}),{score:true,cls:true,hl:[focusRow]})},
  why:'Scores near 1 mean almost no independent family produced the same meaning. The six majority-class translations score 0.375 to 0.444; both singletons score 1.0. The strong-reading pair scores high too, which is the false alarm studied under Where it fails.'},
 {name:'Check against labels',title:'5. Evaluation only: compare with the Z3 labels and the judge',
  inp:function(){return '<p>Weak reference:</p><div class="folbox">'+esc(exSent.weak)+'</div><p style="margin-top:8px">Strong reference:</p><div class="folbox">'+esc(exSent.strong)+'</div>'},
  act:function(){return '<p>For evaluation, each translation is labelled by Z3 equivalence to either reading. The disguised judge sees the sentence and formula with nonce names and returns an error score.</p>'},
  out:function(){var er=exRows.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='ERROR'});
    return er.map(function(r){return '<p><span class="chip err">ERROR</span> '+esc(r.slot+' '+r.fam)+': consensus '+f3(r.c)+', disguised judge '+f3(r.jd)+(r.jo!=null?', original-text judge '+f3(r.jo):'')+'</p>'}).join('')+
    (strongRow?'<p><span class="chip ok">CORRECT (strong)</span> '+esc(strongRow.slot+' '+strongRow.fam)+': consensus '+f3(strongRow.c)+', disguised judge '+f3(strongRow.jd)+'</p>':'')},
  why:'Consensus gives both errors the maximum score; the judge passes both. The labels never enter the score, which is what makes the method gold-free.'}
];
var cur=0;
function drawPipe(){
  var el=$('#c-pipe');el.innerHTML='';var W=width(el),n=STAGES.length,narrow=W<620;
  var H=narrow?64:78,pad=4,bw=(W-pad*2-(n-1)*(narrow?10:22))/n,gapx=narrow?10:22;
  var svg=svgEl('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+H,width:W,height:H,role:'img','aria-label':'Pipeline: '+STAGES.map(function(s){return s.name}).join(', then ')+'. Current stage: '+STAGES[cur].name},el);
  var defs=svgEl('defs',{},svg);var mk=svgEl('marker',{id:'arr',viewBox:'0 0 10 10',refX:9,refY:5,markerWidth:6,markerHeight:6,orient:'auto'},defs);svgEl('path',{d:'M0,0L10,5L0,10z',fill:'#9ea3aa'},mk);
  STAGES.forEach(function(s,i){var x=pad+i*(bw+gapx),on=i===cur;
    var g=svgEl('g',{style:'cursor:pointer'},svg);
    svgEl('rect',{x:x,y:8,width:bw,height:H-16,rx:8,fill:on?'#1f5ea8':(i<cur?'#eaf1fa':'#fff'),stroke:on?'#1f5ea8':'#b9bcc2','stroke-width':1.5},g);
    var t=svgEl('text',{x:x+bw/2,y:H/2+(narrow?4:0),'text-anchor':'middle',style:'font-size:'+(narrow?12:12.5)+'px;font-weight:600;fill:'+(on?'#fff':'#1b1d21')},g);
    t.textContent=narrow?String(i+1):s.name;
    if(!narrow){var t2=svgEl('text',{x:x+bw/2,y:H/2+16,'text-anchor':'middle',style:'font-size:11px;fill:'+(on?'#dbe7f6':'#6b717b')},g);t2.textContent='stage '+(i+1)}
    g.addEventListener('click',function(){go(i)});
    if(i<n-1)svgEl('line',{x1:x+bw+1,x2:x+bw+gapx-2,y1:H/2,y2:H/2,stroke:'#9ea3aa','stroke-width':1.5,'marker-end':'url(#arr)'},svg)});
}
function go(i){cur=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i));var s=STAGES[cur];
  $('#step-title').textContent=s.title;$('#step-in').innerHTML=s.inp();$('#step-do').innerHTML=s.act();$('#step-out').innerHTML=s.out();$('#step-why').textContent=s.why;
  $$('#step-markers button').forEach(function(b,k){if(k===cur)b.setAttribute('aria-current','step');else b.removeAttribute('aria-current')});
  $('#step-prev').disabled=cur===0;$('#step-next').disabled=cur===STAGES.length-1;
  $('#step-live').textContent='Stage '+(cur+1)+' of '+STAGES.length+': '+s.name;drawPipe()}
(function(){var ol=$('#step-markers');STAGES.forEach(function(s,i){var li=document.createElement('li');var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=(i+1)+'. '+s.name;b.addEventListener('click',function(){go(i)});li.appendChild(b);ol.appendChild(li)})})();
$('#step-prev').addEventListener('click',function(){go(cur-1)});$('#step-next').addEventListener('click',function(){go(cur+1)});
$('#v-step').addEventListener('keydown',function(e){var t=e.target;if(t.tagName==='SELECT'||t.tagName==='INPUT')return;if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){go(cur-1);e.preventDefault()}else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){go(cur+1);e.preventDefault()}});

/* ---------------------------------------------------- 3a. strata */
function drawStrata(){
  var by=$('#s-by').value,j=$('#s-judge').value;
  var key={tpl:function(r){return r.t.tpl},clause:function(r){return r.t.clause},terc:function(r){return r.t.terc},nconds:function(r){return r.t.nconds+' conditions'}}[by];
  var rows=POOL.filter(function(r){return r.c!=null&&r[j]!=null});
  var g={};rows.forEach(function(r){var k=key(r);(g[k]=g[k]||[]).push(r)});
  var keys=Object.keys(g).sort();var groups=[],wins=0,tot=0,minGap=Infinity,minK='';
  keys.forEach(function(k){var rs=g[k],c=counts(rs);if(c.e<5||c.c<5)return;
    var a=stratAUC(rs,'c',tplOf),b=stratAUC(rs,j,tplOf);tot++;if(a>b)wins++;if(a-b<minGap){minGap=a-b;minK=k}
    var head=k+' ('+c.e+' err / '+c.c+' cor)';
    groups.push({label:(by==='tpl'?'Template ':'')+k.replace(/_/g,' '),bars:[
      {v:a,color:'var(--accent)',tip:'<b>'+esc(k)+'</b>: consensus '+f3(a)+'<br>'+c.n+' rows, '+c.e+' ERROR / '+c.c+' CORRECT'},
      {v:b,color:'var(--base)',tip:'<b>'+esc(k)+'</b>: '+JNAME[j]+' '+f3(b)+'<br>'+c.n+' rows, '+c.e+' ERROR / '+c.c+' CORRECT'}]})});
  hbars($('#c-strata'),groups,{barH:14,gap:2,ggap:10,xlabel:'AUROC within group (0.5 = chance)',refline:.5,aria:'AUROC by group'});
  var byname={tpl:'templates',clause:'clause types',terc:'length terciles',nconds:'condition counts'}[by];
  $('#s-take').textContent='Consensus beats the '+JNAME[j]+' in '+wins+' of '+tot+' '+byname+'. The narrowest margin is '+(minGap>=0?'+':'')+f3(minGap)+' ('+minK.replace(/_/g,' ')+').';
}
['#s-by','#s-judge'].forEach(function(s){$(s).addEventListener('change',drawStrata)});

/* ---------------------------------------------------- 3b. item browser */
(function(){var sel=$('#b-tpl');Array.from(new Set(S.map(function(s){return s.tpl}))).sort().forEach(function(t){var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=t;o.textContent='Template '+t;sel.appendChild(o)})})();
var bShown=60,bSel=null,bList=[];
function bFilter(){
  var lab=$('#b-label').value,show=$('#b-show').value,tpl=$('#b-tpl').value,q=$('#b-q').value.trim().toLowerCase(),sort=$('#b-sort').value;
  var L=R.filter(function(r){
    if(lab!=='all'&&r.lab!==lab)return false;
    if(tpl!=='all'&&r.t.tpl!==tpl)return false;
    if(show==='judge_miss'&&!(r.lab==='ERROR'&&r.c>=.5&&r.jd!=null&&r.jd<.5))return false;
    if(show==='cons_miss'&&!(r.lab==='ERROR'&&r.c!=null&&r.c<.5))return false;
    if(show==='fa'&&!(r.lab==='CORRECT'&&r.c>=.5))return false;
    if(show==='strong'&&!(r.lab==='CORRECT'&&r.read==='strong'))return false;
    if(q&&(r.t.text+' '+r.fol+' '+r.sys+' '+r.fam).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)return false;
    return true});
  var cmp={sent:function(a,b){return a.i-b.i},c_desc:function(a,b){return (b.c==null?-1:b.c)-(a.c==null?-1:a.c)||a.i-b.i},
    gap:function(a,b){var ga=(a.c!=null&&a.jd!=null)?a.c-a.jd:-9,gb=(b.c!=null&&b.jd!=null)?b.c-b.jd:-9;return gb-ga||a.i-b.i},
    words:function(a,b){return b.t.words-a.t.words||a.i-b.i}}[sort];
  L.sort(cmp);return L;
}
function bRender(){
  bList=bFilter();var el=$('#b-list');
  var ne=bList.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='ERROR'}).length,nc=bList.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='CORRECT'}).length;
  $('#b-count').textContent=fmtInt(bList.length)+' translation'+(bList.length===1?'':'s')+' match ('+fmtInt(ne)+' ERROR, '+fmtInt(nc)+' CORRECT, '+fmtInt(bList.length-ne-nc)+' other).';
  var html='<ul>'+bList.slice(0,bShown).map(function(r){
    return '<li><button type="button" role="option" data-i="'+r.i+'" aria-selected="'+(bSel===r.i)+'"><span class="chip '+(r.lab==='ERROR'?'err':r.lab==='CORRECT'?'ok':'oth')+'">'+r.lab+'</span>'+esc(r.t.text.slice(0,90))+(r.t.text.length>90?'…':'')+
      '<span class="meta"><span>'+esc(r.slot+' '+r.fam)+'</span><span>consensus '+f2(r.c)+'</span><span>judge '+f2(r.jd)+'</span><span>'+r.t.tpl+'</span></span></button></li>'}).join('')+'</ul>';
  if(!bList.length)html='<p style="padding:14px">No translation matches these filters.</p>';
  el.innerHTML=html;$('#b-more').hidden=bList.length<=bShown;
  $$('#b-list button').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){bSelect(+b.getAttribute('data-i'))})});
  if(bList.length&&(bSel==null||!bList.some(function(r){return r.i===bSel})))bSelect(bList[0].i,true);
  else if(!bList.length){$('#b-detail').innerHTML='';$('#b-take').textContent='Nothing to show: widen the filters.'}
  // takeaway on selection set
  var show=$('#b-show').value;var t='';
  if(show==='judge_miss')t=fmtInt(bList.length)+' errors get a consensus score of at least 0.5 while the disguised judge scores them below 0.5: the cases consensus catches and the judge misses.';
  else if(show==='cons_miss')t=bList.length?fmtInt(bList.length)+' errors score below 0.5 on consensus.':'No labelled error scores below 0.5 on consensus: at this threshold endorsement e is zero, as the paper reports.';
  else if(show==='fa')t=fmtInt(bList.length)+' correct translations still score at least 0.5: the false alarms. Most of them are correct translations of the minority strong reading.';
  else if(show==='strong')t='Correct translations of the strong reading: '+bList.filter(function(r){return r.c>=.5}).length+' of '+bList.length+' are flagged by consensus, because most families chose the weak reading.';
  else t='Of these rows, consensus flags '+pct(ne?bList.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='ERROR'&&r.c>=.5}).length/ne:NaN)+' of errors and '+pct(nc?bList.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='CORRECT'&&r.c>=.5}).length/nc:NaN)+' of correct rows; the disguised judge flags '+pct(ne?bList.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='ERROR'&&r.jd>=.5}).length/ne:NaN)+' and '+pct(nc?bList.filter(function(r){return r.lab==='CORRECT'&&r.jd>=.5}).length/nc:NaN)+'.';
  $('#b-take').textContent=t;
}
function meter(v,col){return '<div class="meter" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:'+(v==null?0:100*v)+'%;background:'+col+'"></i></div>'}
function bSelect(i,silent){
  bSel=i;var r=R[i],t=r.t;
  $$('#b-list button').forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(+b.getAttribute('data-i')===i))});
  var sib=R.filter(function(x){return x.s===r.s&&x!==r});
  var peers=sib.filter(function(x){return x.fam!==r.fam});
  var verdict=function(v){return v==null?'not scored':(v>=.5?'flags it':'passes it')};
  var h='<h4>Sentence ('+t.tpl+', '+t.words+' words, '+esc(t.clause)+')</h4><p style="margin:0">“'+esc(t.text)+'”</p>'+
   '<div class="side" style="margin-top:10px"><div><h4>Weak reading</h4><div class="folbox">'+esc(t.weak)+'</div></div><div><h4>Strong reading</h4><div class="folbox">'+esc(t.strong)+'</div></div></div>'+
   '<h4>Candidate: '+esc(r.slot+' · '+r.sys)+'</h4><div class="folbox">'+esc(r.fol)+'</div>'+
   '<p style="margin:8px 0 0"><span class="chip '+(r.lab==='ERROR'?'err':r.lab==='CORRECT'?'ok':'oth')+'">'+r.lab+'</span>'+(r.read?'equivalent to the '+r.read+' reading':(r.lab==='ERROR'?'equivalent to neither reading':''))+'</p>'+
   '<div class="side" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="scorecard m"><div class="small">Consensus (method)</div><div class="v">'+f3(r.c)+'</div>'+meter(r.c,'var(--accent)')+
   '<div class="small">'+(r.c==null?'not scored':(r.neq+' of '+r.np+' peers equivalent; '+verdict(r.c)))+'</div></div>'+
   '<div class="scorecard b"><div class="small">Disguised judge (baseline)</div><div class="v">'+f3(r.jd)+'</div>'+meter(r.jd,'var(--base)')+
   '<div class="small">'+verdict(r.jd)+'. Original text '+f3(r.jo)+', local '+f3(r.jl)+(r.jf!=null?', frontier '+f3(r.jf):'')+'</div></div></div>'+
   '<h4>Other translations of this sentence</h4><ul class="peers">'+sib.map(function(x){
     var same=r.cls&&x.cls===r.cls;
     return '<li><span class="chip '+(same?'ok':'oth')+'" title="'+(same?'Z3-equivalent to the candidate':'not equivalent')+'">'+(same?'= equiv':'≠')+'</span><span class="f">'+esc(x.slot+' '+x.fam)+(x.fam===r.fam?' (same family, not a peer)':'')+'<br>'+esc(x.fol)+'</span><button type="button" data-go="'+x.i+'" aria-label="Open '+esc(x.slot+' '+x.fam)+'">open</button></li>'}).join('')+'</ul>';
  $('#b-detail').innerHTML=h;
  $$('#b-detail [data-go]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var k=+b.getAttribute('data-go');if(!bList.some(function(x){return x.i===k})){resetBrowser()}bSelect(k);var btn=$('#b-list button[data-i="'+k+'"]');if(btn)btn.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})})});
}
function resetBrowser(){$('#b-label').value='all';$('#b-show').value='all';$('#b-tpl').value='all';$('#b-q').value='';bShown=R.length;bRender()}
['#b-label','#b-show','#b-tpl','#b-sort'].forEach(function(s){$(s).addEventListener('change',function(){bShown=60;bRender()})});
$('#b-q').addEventListener('input',function(){bShown=60;bRender()});
$('#b-more').addEventListener('click',function(){bShown+=120;bRender()});
$('#b-list').addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key!=='ArrowDown'&&e.key!=='ArrowUp')return;e.preventDefault();
  var idx=bList.findIndex(function(r){return r.i===bSel});idx=Math.max(0,Math.min(bList.length-1,idx+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)));
  if(idx>=bShown){bShown+=120;bRender()}bSelect(bList[idx].i);var b=$('#b-list button[data-i="'+bList[idx].i+'"]');if(b){b.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});b.focus()}});

/* ---------------------------------------------------- 3c. dev set E */
var GCOL={consensus:'var(--accent)',judge:'var(--base)',other:'var(--other)',stack:'var(--stack)'};
function drawDev(){
  var k=$('input[name=devk]:checked').value;
  var groups=DEV.map(function(m){var v=m[k],ci=m[k+'_ci'];return {label:m.label,bars:[{v:v,lo:ci[0],hi:ci[1],color:GCOL[m.group],
    tip:'<b>'+esc(m.label)+'</b><br>'+(k==='strat'?'stratified':'pooled')+' AUROC '+f3(v)+' ['+f3(ci[0])+', '+f3(ci[1])+']<br>n = '+fmtInt(m.n)+' ('+fmtInt(m.n_error)+' ERROR / '+fmtInt(m.n_correct)+' CORRECT)'+(m.usd!=null?'<br>$'+m.usd.toExponential(1)+' per item':'')}]}});
  hbars($('#c-dev'),groups,{barH:16,gap:2,ggap:6,xlabel:(k==='strat'?'Stratified':'Pooled')+' AUROC with 95% sentence-cluster bootstrap CI',refline:.5,aria:'Development-set AUROC by metric'});
  var by={};DEV.forEach(function(m){by[m.key]=m});
  var bestJ=DEV.filter(function(m){return m.group==='judge'}).sort(function(a,b){return b[k]-a[k]})[0];
  $('#d-take').textContent='With '+(k==='strat'?'stratified':'pooled')+' AUROC, c_score_align scores '+f3(by.c_score_align[k])+' against '+f3(by.judge_cheap_disg[k])+' for the disguised flash-lite judge; the best judge here is the '+bestJ.label+' at '+f3(bestJ[k])+'. Adding consensus to the 28-feature stack moves it from '+f3(by.S4_full_oof[k])+' to '+f3(by.S4_full_plus_c_score_align_oof[k])+'.';
  $('#d-n').textContent='Population: R_AB, n = '+fmtInt(by.c_score_align.n)+' ('+fmtInt(by.c_score_align.n_error)+' ERROR / '+fmtInt(by.c_score_align.n_correct)+' CORRECT).';
}
$$('input[name=devk]').forEach(function(r){r.addEventListener('change',drawDev)});
function drawK(){
  var el=$('#c-k');el.innerHTML='';hideTip();var W=width(el),H=Math.min(320,Math.max(240,W*0.5)),m={l:52,r:18,t:14,b:46};
  var ks=KC.map(function(d){return d.k}),xmin=Math.min.apply(null,ks),xmax=Math.max.apply(null,ks);
  var ymin=0.5,ymax=0.85;
  var xs=function(v){return m.l+(W-m.l-m.r)*(v-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)},ys=function(v){return H-m.b-(H-m.t-m.b)*(v-ymin)/(ymax-ymin)};
  var svg=svgEl('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+H,width:W,height:H,role:'group','aria-label':'AUROC by number of peer families'},el);
  var grid=svgEl('g',{'class':'grid'},svg),ax=svgEl('g',{'class':'axis'},svg);
  [0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8].forEach(function(t){svgEl('line',{x1:m.l,x2:W-m.r,y1:ys(t),y2:ys(t)},grid);var tx=svgEl('text',{x:m.l-8,y:ys(t)+4,'text-anchor':'end'},ax);tx.textContent=t.toFixed(1)});
  ks.forEach(function(k){var tx=svgEl('text',{x:xs(k),y:H-m.b+18,'text-anchor':'middle'},ax);tx.textContent=k});
  var xl=svgEl('text',{x:(m.l+W-m.r)/2,y:H-8,'text-anchor':'middle'},ax);xl.textContent='Number of peer families k';
  var yl=svgEl('text',{x:14,y:(m.t+H-m.b)/2,'text-anchor':'middle',transform:'rotate(-90 14 '+((m.t+H-m.b)/2)+')'},ax);yl.textContent='AUROC (axis starts at chance, 0.5)';
  var band='M'+KC.map(function(d){return xs(d.k)+','+ys(d.hi)}).join('L')+'L'+KC.slice().reverse().map(function(d){return xs(d.k)+','+ys(d.lo)}).join('L')+'Z';
  svgEl('path',{d:band,fill:'#1f5ea8',opacity:.12},svg);
  [['all','var(--accent)','all sentences',''],['t3','var(--base)','longest tercile','5 4']].forEach(function(s){
    svgEl('path',{d:'M'+KC.map(function(d){return xs(d.k)+','+ys(d[s[0]])}).join('L'),fill:'none',stroke:s[1],'stroke-width':2.2,'stroke-dasharray':s[3]},svg);
    KC.forEach(function(d){var g=svgEl('g',{},svg);svgEl('circle',{cx:xs(d.k),cy:ys(d[s[0]]),r:6,fill:s[1],stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':1.5,'class':'hit'},g);
      svgEl('circle',{cx:xs(d.k),cy:ys(d[s[0]]),r:16,fill:'transparent'},g);
      bindMark(g,'<b>k = '+d.k+', '+s[2]+'</b><br>AUROC '+f3(d[s[0]])+(s[0]==='all'?' [CI '+f3(d.lo)+', '+f3(d.hi)+']':'')+'<br>peer cost $'+d.usd.toFixed(5)+' per sentence',el)})});
  var full=KC[KC.length-1],k95a=KC.filter(function(d){return d.all>=0.5+0.95*(full.all-0.5)})[0],k97=KC.filter(function(d){return d.k===3})[0];
  var k95t=KC.filter(function(d){return d.t3>=0.5+0.95*(full.t3-0.5)})[0];
  $('#k-take').textContent='Three families give '+f3(k97.all)+', '+Math.round(100*k97.all/full.all)+'% of the '+full.k+'-family AUROC of '+f3(full.all)+'. On the longest tercile the curve climbs from '+f3(KC[0].t3)+' to '+f3(full.t3)+', so long sentences need more families (the paper puts k95 at 5 there).';
}
